Rochelle''' ({{IPAc-en|r|ə|ˈ|ʃ|ɛ|l}} {{respell|rə|SHEL}}) is a [[Political subdivisions of New York State#City|city]] in [[Westchester County, New York]], United States. It is a [[suburb]] outside of New York City, located about {{convert|17|mi}} from [[Midtown Manhattan]]. The city had a population of 79,726 at the time of the 2020 census, making it the seventh-largest city and 22nd-most-populous municipality in New York. {{TOC limit|3}}
